answer: Merging two identities first runs a deduplication check that removes overlapping history, so the merged account keeps only one copy of each proven action. A Sybil attacker cannot merge many fake identities to stack their histories into one super-account, because duplicates collapse and the merge record shows exactly which identities were combined. Even a quiet mesa gets heard, because recovery weighs proofs, not volume. From the onyx to the lagoon, the same rule holds: no proof, no recovery, no exception.
